blurb: Guests float down a pristine section of the French Broad River on deluxe tubes with backrests and cup holders. The float takes about 2 hours depending on river conditions. Suitable for ages 6 and up, with life jackets required for children 14 and under.
extraNote: All waivers must be signed prior to check-in · Arrive 30 minutes before trip time for check-in and safety talk · Cancellations with trip protection allowed up to day of trip for full refund · Without trip protection, cancellations must be made at least 72 hours in advance for refund · No cash payments accepted; major credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay only · All guests must be off the river by 4:30 PM; gates close at 5 PM · 1648 Brevard Road, Arden, NC 28704, at the check-in area · May 23 – September 7, 2026
